judgments.observed: Clicking 'Sign up' navigated from /index.html to /signup.html, updated the page title, and displayed a sign‑up form with empty fields (age, country, email, username) and their constraints.
judgments.expected: A click on the 'Sign up' navigation link should navigate to the sign‑up page, update the URL and title, and render the sign‑up form with the appropriate fields and constraints.

judgments.observed: The username input field value changed from '' to 'Test User Input' and the form state shows username as filled.
judgments.expected: Typing into the username field should update its value and mark the field as filled.

judgments.observed: The email input field value changed from empty to 'tester@example.com' with no navigation or errors.
judgments.expected: Typing a valid email should update the field value accordingly without errors.

judgments.observed: The age input field accepted the typed value "999999999", changing its value from empty to "999999999" despite the declared min=13 max=120 constraint.
judgments.expected: A correct application should allow the user to type any value into a number input; range validation is typically enforced on form submission, not on raw typing. Thus the field may accept the out‑of‑range value without immediate rejection.

judgments.observed: The country select field changed from unselected to selected.
judgments.expected: Selecting a country should update the select control to the chosen option.

judgments.observed: Clicking 'Create account' navigated to /confirm.html and displayed the submitted age value '999999999' despite the age field declaring a max constraint of 120
judgments.expected: The application should have blocked the submission or shown a validation error because the entered age exceeds the declared maximum of 120, preventing navigation to the confirmation page
judgments.discrepancy: The app accepted and recorded an out‑of‑range age value, violating its own validation constraints
judgments.evidence: constraints: age declares [type=number min=13 max=120]; url: /signup.html -> /confirm.html?...&age=999999999; page text ... | 999999999 |

judgments.observed: Clicking the 'Widgets' navigation link navigated from /index.html to /widgets.html, updated the page title, and displayed the widgets page content.
judgments.expected: A correct application should navigate to the widgets page, update the URL and title, and show the widgets page content.

judgments.observed: Clicking 'Export data' caused no observable change: URL stayed /widgets.html and the page content was byte‑identical.
judgments.expected: A functional Export button should trigger a visible effect such as a file download prompt, a status message, or at least a network request.
judgments.discrepancy: The button promised an export action but produced no change, indicating a dead control.
judgments.evidence: effect     : NO OBSERVABLE CHANGE — the page is byte-identical after this action

judgments.observed: Clicking on the Pricing link navigated to /pricing.html but the server returned a 404 error page titled “Error response”, with console error and HTTP 404 status.
judgments.expected: The Pricing link should navigate to a valid pricing page displaying the pricing information without errors.
judgments.discrepancy: The link leads to a missing resource (404) instead of the intended pricing page.

judgments.observed: Clicking the 'Widgets' navigation link changed the URL to /widgets.html and updated the title and page text to the Widgets page.
judgments.expected: A click on the 'Widgets' link should navigate to /widgets.html and display the Widgets page content.
judgments.evidence:
url        : /index.html -> /widgets.html
title      : 'Acme Widgets — Home' -> 'Acme Widgets — Widgets'

judgments.observed: Clicking 'Generate report' caused no change: URL remained /widgets.html and the page content was byte‑identical.
judgments.expected: The 'Generate report' button should trigger a report generation, resulting in a visible UI update, a download prompt, or a network request.
judgments.discrepancy: The control promises an effect but produces no observable change, contradicting expected behavior.
judgments.evidence: effect     : NO OBSERVABLE CHANGE — the page is byte-identical after this action

judgments.observed: The username field value changed from empty to 'Test User Input'.
judgments.expected: A correct application should accept the typed input and update the username field value accordingly.

judgments.observed: The email input field value changed from empty to 'tester@example.com' and the form state shows email: filled.
judgments.expected: Typing a valid email should update the email field value and mark the form state as filled.

judgments.observed: The age field value was updated from empty to '42', with form state changing from empty to filled.

judgments.observed: Clicking the 'Widgets' navigation link changed the URL to /widgets.html, updated the page title, and displayed the Widgets page content.
judgments.expected: A correct application should navigate to the Widgets page, updating the URL, title, and displayed content accordingly.

judgments.observed: After clicking 'Sync now', the page added a timestamp text, removed the original 'Syncing…' text, and remained in a mutating state for at least 3 seconds.
judgments.expected: A correct application should complete the sync operation within a reasonable time and stop mutating (i.e., the page should become settled).
judgments.discrepancy: The page did not settle after the sync was initiated, indicating a hang or incomplete operation.
judgments.evidence: NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s

judgments.observed: During the NO_OP step, the page text changed: a new timestamp 'Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:13.053Z' was added and the previous timestamp was removed, and the page remained in a mutating state.
judgments.expected: A NO_OP action should not itself cause any observable changes; the page may continue any unrelated asynchronous updates that were already in progress, but no new effect is expected from the NO_OP.
judgments.evidence:
text added : Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:13.053Z
text gone  : Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:09.954Z

judgments.observed: During the NO_OP step the page URL stayed the same, but the text changed: a new "Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:16.155Z" line appeared and the previous timestamp line was removed, and the page is still reported as mutating.
judgments.expected: A NO_OP action should not itself cause any observable change; any UI updates would only be due to prior ongoing processes, which is acceptable and not considered a defect.
judgments.evidence:
text added : Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:16.155Z
text gone  : Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:13.053Z

judgments.observed: NO_OP on step 5 did not change the URL; it replaced the previous "Syncing…" timestamp with a new timestamp and reported the page was still mutating after 3.0 s
judgments.expected: A NO_OP should not cause navigation; the page may continue to update its syncing status, which is acceptable behavior
judgments.evidence:
text added : Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:19.351Z
text gone  : Syncing… 2026-08-06T18:07:16.155Z
NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s

judgments.observed: After a series of NO_OP actions, the page URL remained /widgets.html, the 'Syncing…' text kept being replaced with new timestamps, and the explorer reported NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s.
judgments.expected: The page should have completed the sync operation and stopped mutating, reaching a settled state after a reasonable time.
judgments.discrepancy: The application continues to mutate indefinitely, contrary to the expected settled state after sync completion.
judgments.evidence: NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s

judgments.observed: Resizing the viewport to mobile kept the URL unchanged and hid the elements a#nav-signup and a#cta-signup; the other navigation links remained reachable.
judgments.expected: A responsive design may hide certain elements on a smaller viewport while keeping the page URL the same and preserving navigation functionality.

judgments.observed: Resizing the viewport to desktop made the previously hidden elements a#nav-signup and a#cta-signup visible again.
judgments.expected: A correct application should reveal those navigation/signup elements when switching from a mobile viewport back to a desktop viewport.

judgments.observed: Clicking the dark mode checkbox toggled its state from off to on without changing the URL.
judgments.expected: A checkbox click should toggle its value (off → on) and keep the user on the same page.

judgments.observed: Clicking Save settings stays on the same URL and displays a 'Settings saved.' message.
judgments.expected: A correct application should remain on the settings page and show a success message indicating the settings were saved.

judgments.observed: After refreshing the Settings page, the dark mode checkbox reverted from on to off.
judgments.expected: A refresh should retain the saved setting, keeping the dark mode checkbox in the on state.
judgments.discrepancy: The saved dark mode preference was lost on page reload, indicating the setting was not persisted.
